newsitem.title: USA: Access Beyond stake upped by Cramer group.
newsitem.headline: Access Beyond stake upped by Cramer group.

text.p: A group led by New York investor James Cramer said Thursday it raised its stake in Access Beyond Inc to 2,503,100 common shares or 20.9 percent.
In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said its latest transactions include buying 153,600 common shares between Jan 7 and Feb 18 at $6.50 to $7.4375 per share.
Access Beyond is a Gaithersburg, Md., maker of remote access products. The company was formerly part of Penril DataComm Networks.
